title: Replication package: The Bitcoin Intergenerational Wealth Framework — A Demographic Floor for Bitcoin and the Reinvention of the Banking Business Model (CVA Academic Research Journal 2026)
description: Code and derived data reproducing all tables and model figures of the paper submitted to the Crypto Valley Association Academic Research Journal 2026 (CFP: On-Chain Finance and the Reinvention of Financial Infrastructure). Deterministic price results (Tables 3, 4, 6) reproduce exactly via asserted checks in code/reproduce_cva.py; the AUM-migration funnel (Table 7, Figures 4 and 8) is recomputed by code/aum_migration.py; model figures are regenerated by code/make_figures_cva.py. Data files are derived series; raw third-party microdata are not redistributed — provenance in data/MANIFEST.md. Code: MIT. Data and figures: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Companion to the authors' Zenodo deposit 10.5281/zenodo.21584815 (a different paper built on the same demographic engine); this package carries the CVA paper's own tables, figures and the banking (AUM-migration) code.
